audience: developers and data teams that run Postgres databases on Neon

useCases.title: Review the branches of a project
useCases.text: List the projects the key can see, then list the branches of one project. Get one branch to read its state, parent and size.

useCases.title: Inspect the schema of a database on a branch
useCases.text: List the databases and roles of a branch. Role passwords are never returned. Read the schema of one database as text.

useCases.title: Check compute endpoints and usage
useCases.text: List the compute endpoints of a project with their state. Get the usage per project for an organization over a time range.

useCases.title: Create a branch to test a change
useCases.text: Create a branch from a parent branch. The copy uses copy-on-write, so no data is duplicated. Check the operation until it finishes.

useCases.title: Start or suspend a compute endpoint
useCases.text: Start a suspended compute endpoint, or suspend a running one. Connections to it stop until it starts again.
